title: The integer multiplicity current c[[ℝⁿ]]
statement: Let n ≥ 1 and c ∈ ℤ. Then there is C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝⁿ) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) which is integer multiplicity and satisfies C(ω) = c·∫_{ℝⁿ} ω(y)(e) dLⁿ(y) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝⁿ), where e = (e₁, …, eₙ) is the standard basis of ℝⁿ (EuclideanSpace.basisFun) — i.e. C = c[[ℝⁿ]] with the standard orientation e₁∧…∧eₙ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℤ), 0 < n → ∃ C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid n)) n, IsIntegerMultiplicity C ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid n)) n, C ω = (c : ℝ) * ∫ y, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) y ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ)
